node.label: 1. 确定增益 K 以满足误差要求：选取 K 以满足误差常数（Kp、Kv 或 Ka），从而满足稳态误差 ess 指标。2. 利用步骤 1 中得到的 K 值计算未校正系统的相位裕度 PM。3. 留出额外裕量（约 10°），并确定所需的最大超前相位 φmax。4. 根据式 (6.40) 或图 6.53 确定 α。5. 选取 ωmax 为截止频率；因此零点位于 1/TD = ωmax √α，极点位于 1/αTD = ωmax / √α。6. 绘制校正后的频率响应曲线并检验 PM。7. 对设计进行迭代。
node.description: 1. Determine the gain K to satisfy error requirements: pick K to satisfy error constants (Kp, Kv, or Ka) so that ess error specification is met. 2. Evaluate the PM of the uncompensated system using the value of K obtained from Step 1. 3. Allow for extra margin (about 10°), and determine the needed phase lead φmax. 4. Determine α from Eq. (6.40) or Fig. 6.53. 5. Pick ωmax to be at the crossover frequency; thus the zero is at 1/TD = ωmax √α and the pole is at 1/αTD = ωmax / √α. 6. Draw the compensated frequency response and check the PM. 7. Iterate on the design.
